stem.text: Which statement explains why alpha-particles have discrete energies, but beta-particles have a continuous range of energies?

A.text: Beta-particles have a much smaller mass than alpha-particles which means beta-particles can be emitted with a larger range of velocities.

B.text: Only alpha-particles experience repulsion from the nucleus which is dependent on the number of protons in the nucleus.

C.text: Only beta-particles are emitted with another lepton and some energy is transferred to the other lepton.

D.text: Only the energy of alpha-particles is discrete because the composition of alpha-particles is always the same.
